source: Super Minds 1 First Edition Teacher's Book
scope: Year 1 verified textbook-linked lessons; paraphrased guidance

guidance.aims: Present the picture story and recycle language from Friends.
guidance.warm_up: Review pupils' names and ages through short teacher-pupil exchanges.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Review the four Super Friends, play the story, pause to identify characters and the cat, then replay frame by frame for pupils to listen and repeat.
guidance.workbook_procedure: Use WB p8 to review story phrases and match each Super Friend to the correct power.
guidance.audio_procedure: Use the verified story recording for SB pp8–9; WB p8 uses CD1 Track 11.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pause at key frames and ask pupils to identify who is speaking; check WB responses as a class.
guidance.ending_lesson: Put pupils in groups of five to rehearse and perform the story roles.
guidance.extension_optional: Call out short phrases from the story and ask pupils to identify the speaker.

guidance.aims: Discuss the story meaning, recycle unit language and help pupils reflect on learning.
guidance.warm_up: Mime the Super Friends' powers and let pupils identify the character.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Replay the story with books closed, then have pairs read and number the pictures on SB p9; compare pair answers before whole-class checking.
guidance.workbook_procedure: On WB p9 pupils draw and write examples showing what they know from the unit.
guidance.audio_procedure: Replay the previously verified Friends story recording; no new exact track is introduced on this TB page.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare answers with another pair before class feedback.
guidance.ending_lesson: Review numbers 1–10 using the Workbook picture dictionary in pairs.
guidance.extension_optional: Spell familiar unit words aloud and ask pupils to identify and locate the words.

guidance.aims: Present and practise classroom objects and perform the unit chant.
guidance.warm_up: Run a true/false colour review using objects around the classroom.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Present classroom-object flashcards, play the SB p10 recording for pupils to point and repeat, then use the chant first as a class and then in groups while pupils hold up relevant objects.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p10: match classroom-object words to pictures, then colour the objects as instructed.
guidance.audio_procedure: SB p10 uses CD1 Tracks 12 and 13.
guidance.checking_feedback: Use pair pointing/naming practice, then check workbook matching and colours together.
guidance.ending_lesson: Display flashcards around the room; call objects for pupils to point to, then reverse the task by pointing for pupils to name them.

guidance.aims: Practise asking and answering about classroom objects using What's this? and Is it a ...?.
guidance.warm_up: Display classroom-object flashcards with deliberately mismatched labels and let pupils correct them.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p11 listening to number the pictures, model the target questions and answers with real objects, replay for choral repetition, then run the guessing game in groups.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p11: listen and write the classroom-object words, then read statements and tick the correct box.
guidance.audio_procedure: SB p11 uses CD1 Tracks 14 and 15; WB p11 uses CD1 Track 16.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pupils check listening answers in pairs before whole-class confirmation; repeat target exchanges aloud.
guidance.ending_lesson: Slowly draw familiar items on the board while pupils guess using the target question pattern.
guidance.extension_optional: Use a hidden-object guessing game in pairs, with eyes closed instead of a blindfold if preferred.

guidance.aims: Sing the classroom-object song and practise It's my / It isn't my language.
guidance.warm_up: Flash classroom-object cards quickly and ask pupils to identify each item.
guidance.student_book_procedure: Use SB p12 song: identify desk objects, pre-teach 'in a mess', listen, repeat verse by verse and sing; then personalise the song with pupils' own classroom objects and complete the desk-matching task.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p12: follow the lines and build sentences using It's my / It isn't my.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare desk-matching answers before class checking; elicit truthful It's my / It isn't my responses during the song game.
guidance.ending_lesson: Sing the song again while substituting different classroom objects.
guidance.extension_optional: Practise spelling classroom-object words by completing missing letters in pairs.

guidance.aims: Present and practise positive classroom imperatives and following instructions.
guidance.warm_up: Show classroom objects one at a time; pupils write the words, compare spelling in pairs, then check as a class.
guidance.student_book_procedure: On SB p13 pupils listen and choose the correct stickers, write the object words, mime the instructions, repeat the imperative forms, then play a chain game in small groups where each pupil follows and gives a new instruction.
guidance.workbook_procedure: WB p13: read and write classroom-object words, then read and match instructions/items by number.
guidance.audio_procedure: SB p13 uses CD1 Tracks 19 and 20.
guidance.checking_feedback: Pairs compare sticker/listening choices, then check with the class; monitor the chain game for correct imperative use.
guidance.ending_lesson: Play a 'Please' response game: pupils act only when the instruction includes please.
guidance.extension_optional: Invite pupils to lead the class by giving familiar imperative instructions.
